digest.component_or_area: Configuration and credential ownership across reconciler engine, store, snapshot, I/O, CLI, commands, LLM/workflow, and MCP server
propositions: Direct ambient config/credential reads (os.getenv, os.environ, load_config) exist below approved composition seams in ~110 locations across multiple subsystems
Legacy facades, per-job ambient reloads, migration switches, and migration exceptions must be removed only after focused test suites pass and legacy-exception set reaches empty
All below-seam ambient reads must either be cut to compose through approved seams or registered with exact path+symbol+rationale for test-only controls and protocol constants
Behavioral suites S1-S6 must remain green and provider-neutral outcomes unchanged after legacy-facade removal, with only explicitly recorded approved deltas permitted
